title: Class Unit Magma Hecke Comparators
objective: Implement actual exact four-boundary Magma and pinned Hecke 0.40 class/unit corpus comparator adapters with authenticated evidence and focused documentation/tests.

handoff.summary: Implemented authenticated, executable Magma 2.18-5 and pinned Hecke 0.40 class/unit/regulator adapters for all four evidence boundaries. Both adapters use independently prepared calibrated warm batches, fail-closed payload protocols, explicit conditional/unconditional proof semantics, exact runtime and mathematical-library fingerprints, descendant-safe timeouts, and honest RSS scopes. Hecke publishes rigorous Arb regulator intersections and separately times proof upgrades; Magma clears ambient MAGMA_LIBRARIES and authenticates its launcher, static runtime, and complete package tree. The clean exact d8d72b81 receipt at /scratch/class-group/magma-hecke-d8d72b81.json has 16/16 matched jobs, timing acceptance true, memory acceptance false, and fingerprint 44ae2ccdbda2f4c38383c2827767df5e9301d06e388f62ef6693e57a2432e464. Median seconds by conditional/unconditional proof and kernel-warm, field-cold, process-cold, release-cold are Magma conditional [0.01397727294401689, 0.01386363939805464, 0.21, 0.21], Magma unconditional [0.01365384688744178, 0.01365384230246911, 0.21, 0.21], Hecke conditional [0.01830440013636364, 0.018323330090909088, 22.51, 22.7], and Hecke unconditional [0.018834658968749994, 0.018777181687499995, 22.86, 23].
risks: The committed exact timing receipt covers one permanent smoke field with five samples per proof/boundary; the broader tune and held-out tiers remain to be run on an idle benchmark host.
Persistent warm RSS is deliberately a case-process upper bound, so the receipt cannot satisfy the per-operation memory gate; only cold samples have single-operation process peaks.

Magma is proprietary and Hecke uses a host-specific pinned Julia project/depot. Missing or differently pinned installations fail closed as unavailable rather than silently selecting another implementation.

The repository-wide test:changed command reaches the pre-existing stale test-manifest ratchet outside this lane's claims; the focused suite, syntax, diff, parallel contract, exact runtime receipt, and independent review pass.
next_steps: Run the 10-field smoke tier, then the 60-field tuning and 30-field held-out tiers with Sage.js, Sage/PARI, direct GP, Magma, and Hecke on an idle benchmark machine.
Use semantic comparison keys to join only equivalent conditional or unconditional proof/output/regulator contracts when computing performance gates.
Refresh the shared test manifest and run cumulative repository-wide native/strict gates after integration; no native source or compiler input changed in this lane.
